clinician.final_diagnosis: pleomorphic rhabdomyosarcoma in the adult bladder
clinician.trajectory_summary: A 69-year-old male presented with intermittent gross hematuria. Ultrasound identified hypoechoic nodules in the right upper bladder wall. Cystoscopy revealed a 3.0 × 3.0 cm globular bladder mass with a narrow pedicle and surface calcifications. Transurethral resection of bladder tumor (TURBt) and multipoint biopsy were performed in July 2023. Postoperative pathological examination confirmed pleomorphic rhabdomyosarcoma. A pre-chemotherapy PET-CT scan showed no metastasis. Chemotherapy with intravenous dacarbazine and doxorubicin was administered with good adherence and tolerability. A follow-up enhanced CT on December 7, 2023, showed no tumor recurrence.
